reports.title: GLOBAL NET LEASE REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

lines: Reaffirmed Full-Year Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA Guidance of 6.5x – 6.9x
Raises Full-Year AFFO Per Share Guidance to $0.83 – $0.85
The Company’s full-year 2026 Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA guidance range of 6.5x to 6.9x remains unchanged, consistent with the Company’s expectation that the transaction will be leverage neutral.
